# CassetteCat

> CassetteCat is a free, open-source music player for Android, Windows and Linux, made by CaffeineLabs. It plays local music files, streams from your own Navidrome, Jellyfin or other Subsonic server, shows synced lyrics, plays internet radio and works with Android Auto. It has no ads, no analytics and no account. Licensed under GPL-3.0.

## Platforms and downloads

- Android 8.0 or later: [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.caffeinelabs.cassettecat) or the APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/samyyy2311/CassetteCat/releases/latest). Obtainium can track GitHub releases for automatic updates.
- Windows (64-bit): installer (.exe) or portable .zip from [CassetteCat Desktop releases](https://github.com/samyyy2311/CassetteCat-Desktop/releases/latest).
- Linux (x86_64): AppImage, .deb, .rpm, Flatpak or .tar.gz from the same desktop releases page.
- Not available: iPhone, iPad and macOS. The F-Droid listing is pending.

## Features

- Local library: scans device storage and SD cards for FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, Opus, WAV and ALAC, with folder filters and tag support.
- Self-hosted streaming: Jellyfin and any Subsonic-compatible server (Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic, LMS), with offline caching.
- Synced lyrics: reads embedded LRC and ID3 lyrics, falls back to LRCLIB, and includes a lyrics editor.
- Equalizer with AutoEq headphone correction profiles.
- Internet radio through Radio Browser, searchable by name, genre or country.
- Android Auto, Android Automotive OS and a Drive Mode for the car.
- Scrobbling to ListenBrainz and Libre.fm.
- M3U and M3U8 playlist import and export, plus backup and restore of playlists and settings.
- Monthly listening stats (Rewind), a home screen widget, and Listening Room (beta) for synced playback across devices on the same Wi-Fi.
- CassetteCat Player: an open-hardware ESP32 pocket player, still in development, that the phone app can sync songs to and control over Wi-Fi.

## Privacy

No ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking IDs and no user accounts. Listening history and playlists stay on the device. Server passwords are encrypted with the Android Keystore. Online lookups for lyrics, artwork and metadata are optional and can each be turned off.
